senses.en: in a way that shows an intention to harm or frighten

example.en: The dog growled threateningly at the stranger.
example.zh: 狗朝着陌生人发出威胁的低吼。

senses.en: relating to or resembling the stars

example.en: The night sky was filled with astral light.
example.zh: 夜空中充满了星光。

senses.en: to develop industry in a country or region, or make it industrially developed

example.en: The country industrialised rapidly during the twentieth century.
example.zh: 该国在二十世纪迅速实现了工业化。

senses.en: having a strong hot taste from chili or other spices

example.en: This soup is too spicy for me.
example.zh: 这汤对我来说太辣了。

senses.en: flavored with spices

example.en: The dish has a rich spicy flavor.
example.zh: 这道菜香料味浓郁。

senses.en: slightly shocking or risqué in an entertaining way
senses.zh: 带刺激性的；有伤风化的（非正式）

example.en: He told a spicy joke at the party.
example.zh: 他在聚会上讲了个带点刺激的笑话。

senses.en: an insulated box used to keep food or drinks cold

example.en: We packed sandwiches and drinks in the cooler for the picnic.
example.zh: 我们为野餐把三明治和饮料装进了冷藏箱。

senses.en: a device or machine that cools something

example.en: The office cooler keeps the room comfortable in summer.
example.zh: 办公室的冷却器让房间在夏天保持舒适。

senses.en: to be greater in number than someone or something

example.en: Women outnumber men in this company.
example.zh: 在这家公司，女性人数超过男性。

senses.en: to write or carve words on something, especially as a formal or permanent mark

example.en: His name was inscribed on the trophy.
example.zh: 他的名字被刻在了奖杯上。

senses.en: a health professional trained to prepare and dispense medicines

example.en: Ask the pharmacist if this medicine interacts with other drugs.
example.zh: 请咨询药剂师这种药是否与其他药物相互作用。

senses.en: to succeed in dealing with a problem or difficulty

example.en: She worked hard to overcome her fear of public speaking.
example.zh: 她努力克服了当众演讲的恐惧。

senses.en: to defeat someone in a competition or conflict

example.en: The team overcame a strong opponent in the final.
example.zh: 该队在决赛中战胜了一个强劲的对手。

senses.en: to be strongly affected by a feeling, especially so that you cannot think clearly
senses.zh: 被（情绪）压倒；使无法自持

example.en: He was overcome with relief when he heard the news.
example.zh: 听到这个消息时，他如释重负。

senses.en: a number of things placed one on top of another
senses.zh: 一堆叠放在一起的东西

example.en: There was a pile of clean clothes on the bed.
example.zh: 床上有一堆干净的衣服。

senses.en: a large amount or number of something

example.en: She has piles of homework to finish tonight.
example.zh: 她今晚有很多作业要完成。

senses.en: to put things in a pile or stack

example.en: He piled the books on the desk.
example.zh: 他把书堆在桌子上。

senses.en: the rate at which something happens or appears within a period

example.en: The frequency of trains increases during rush hour.
example.zh: 高峰时段列车的频次增加。

senses.en: the number of complete waves that pass a point each second, as in sound, light or radio

example.en: This radio station broadcasts at a frequency of 98.5 megahertz.
example.zh: 这家电台以 98.5 兆赫的频率广播。

senses.en: the number of times a value appears in a set of data

example.en: In statistics, frequency is the number of times a value appears in a data set.
example.zh: 在统计学中，频数是一个值在数据集中出现的次数。

senses.en: the fact of no longer having something or someone

example.en: The loss of his keys made him late for work.
example.zh: 他丢了钥匙，因此上班迟到了。

senses.en: money that a business loses when costs are higher than income

example.en: The store reported a loss after sales fell.
example.zh: 销售额下降后，这家店报告了亏损。

senses.en: a decrease in amount or level

example.en: The company saw a loss of customers last year.
example.zh: 这家公司去年客户减少了。

senses.en: to remember something from the past

example.en: I can't recall where I put the keys.
example.zh: 我想不起来把钥匙放在哪里了。

senses.en: an official request for a defective product to be returned

example.en: The company issued a recall for the faulty batteries.
example.zh: 该公司对有问题的电池发布了召回通知。

senses.en: to officially order someone or something to return

example.en: The manufacturer recalled the toys because of a safety defect.
example.zh: 制造商因安全缺陷召回了这些玩具。

senses.en: A group of citizens sworn to decide a case in a court of law.

example.en: The jury reached a verdict after two days of deliberation.
example.zh: 陪审团经过两天的审议作出了裁决。

senses.en: A committee appointed to judge a competition.

example.en: The jury awarded first prize to a young pianist.
example.zh: 评判委员会把一等奖授予了一位年轻钢琴家。

senses.en: perhaps; maybe

example.en: We may possibly need more time.
example.zh: 我们可能需要更多时间。

senses.en: used after can or could to emphasize impossibility or surprise
senses.zh: （用于 can/could 后）强调不可能或惊讶

example.en: He couldn't possibly finish all that work today.
example.zh: 他今天不可能完成所有那些工作。

senses.en: relating to actual use or action rather than ideas

example.en: The course gives students practical skills for the workplace.
example.zh: 这门课程为学生提供职场实用的技能。

senses.en: based on experience and observation rather than theory
senses.zh: 从实践经验出发的；务实的

example.en: She took a practical approach to fixing the machine.
example.zh: 她采用务实的方法修理这台机器。

senses.en: a lesson or examination in which you do something rather than write answers

example.en: The chemistry practical lasted two hours.
example.zh: 化学实验课持续了两个小时。

senses.en: a layer of material covering the inside surface of something

example.en: The coat has a warm fleece lining.
example.zh: 这件外套有一层保暖的绒布里衬。

senses.en: a layer of material that covers an inner surface of a body part or container
senses.zh: （身体器官或容器等的）内壁，内膜

example.en: The stomach lining protects against acid.
example.zh: 胃内壁可以抵御胃酸。

senses.en: to move upward or rise

example.en: The plane ascended quickly after takeoff.
example.zh: 飞机起飞后迅速上升。

senses.en: to trace back through a family line to an ancestor

example.en: The family tree ascends to ancestors in the 18th century.
example.zh: 这份家谱可追溯到18世纪的祖先。

senses.en: lower in rank or importance

example.en: She takes care of all the subordinate details of the project.
example.zh: 她负责处理该项目所有次要的细节。

senses.en: a person under the authority or control of another

example.en: A good manager listens to his subordinates.
example.zh: 好的管理者会倾听下属的意见。

senses.en: to treat something as less important than something else
senses.zh: 使处于次要地位；使服从

example.en: He subordinated his personal interests to the team's goals.
example.zh: 他把个人利益放在团队目标之下。

senses.en: the quality of happening at even intervals or following a fixed pattern

example.en: Visitors admire the regularity of the tides.
example.zh: 游客们赞叹潮汐的规律性。

senses.en: the quality of being even, orderly, or uniform in shape or arrangement

example.en: The garden is famous for the regularity of its hedges.
example.zh: 这座花园以树篱的整齐匀称而闻名。

senses.en: newly formed or coming into prominence

example.en: The emerging market attracted many investors.
example.zh: 这个新兴市场吸引了许多投资者。

senses.en: present participle of emerge: to come out or become known
senses.zh: 出现；浮现（emerge 的现在分词）

example.en: The sun is emerging from behind the clouds.
example.zh: 太阳正从云层后面露出来。

senses.en: a set of rules for exchanging data between computers or devices

example.en: The devices communicate using a common network protocol.
example.zh: 这些设备使用一种通用网络协议进行通信。

senses.en: the official rules and customs of diplomacy and formal events

example.en: Diplomatic protocol requires guests to arrive on time.
example.zh: 外交礼仪要求来宾准时到场。

senses.en: an official plan or set of procedures, especially for scientific studies or medical treatment
senses.zh: 方案，规程（尤指科研或医疗流程）

example.en: The researchers followed a strict safety protocol.
example.zh: 研究人员遵循了严格的安全规程。

senses.en: relating to theology or the study of God and religion

example.en: The seminary offers courses in theological studies.
example.zh: 这所神学院开设神学课程。

senses.en: coming after the eighth in position

example.en: Her office is on the ninth floor.
example.zh: 她的办公室在九楼。

senses.en: one of nine equal parts

example.en: Nine pounds of flour divided into ninths gives one pound each.
example.zh: 九磅面粉分成九份，每份一磅。

senses.en: very thin

example.en: The skinny cat was rescued from the street.
example.zh: 这只瘦得皮包骨的猫从街上被救了回来。

senses.en: confidential information (informal)

example.en: Give me the skinny on the new project.
example.zh: 跟我说说新项目的内情。

senses.en: difficult to find, catch, or describe
senses.zh: 难以捉摸的；难以找到的

example.en: The exact meaning of the poem remains elusive.
example.zh: 这首诗的确切含义仍然难以捉摸。

senses.en: a period of relaxing or not working

example.en: You need a good rest after the long trip.
example.zh: 长途旅行后你需要好好休息。

senses.en: the part or people that remain after other parts have gone; the remainder

example.en: The rest of the students went home early.
example.zh: 其余的学生早早回家了。

senses.en: to relax or stop working for a while

example.en: She rested for ten minutes before continuing.
example.zh: 她休息了十分钟再继续。

senses.en: to lean or be supported on something

example.en: He rested his head on the desk.
example.zh: 他把头靠在桌子上。

senses.en: containing nothing

example.en: The box is empty.
example.zh: 盒子是空的。

senses.en: to remove everything from something, or to become empty

example.en: She emptied her pockets onto the table.
example.zh: 她把口袋里的东西都倒在桌上。

senses.en: lacking meaning or value

example.en: His promises turned out to be empty.
example.zh: 他的诺言原来是空话。

senses.en: currently happening or continuing

example.en: The police are investigating the ongoing case.
example.zh: 警方正在调查这起进行中的案件。

senses.en: to sit, lie, or stand in a lazy, relaxed way
senses.zh: 懒洋洋地躺（坐、倚）；闲散地待着

example.en: He lolled on the sofa all afternoon.
example.zh: 他整个下午懒洋洋地躺在沙发上。

senses.en: to hang loosely

example.en: The dog lolled its tongue out of the side of its mouth.
example.zh: 狗的舌头松松地垂在嘴边。

senses.en: a thin fungal growth, usually white, that forms on damp surfaces

example.en: There was mildew on the bathroom wall.
example.zh: 浴室的墙上有霉斑。

senses.en: to become covered with mildew

example.en: The curtains mildewed in the damp room.
example.zh: 窗帘在潮湿的房间里发霉了。

senses.en: false or fake, though seeming genuine

example.en: The report was based on spurious data.
example.zh: 这份报告基于虚假数据。

senses.en: concerned with death in a grim or horrifying way
senses.zh: 阴森可怕的，以死亡为主题的

example.en: The film has a macabre atmosphere.
example.zh: 这部电影有一种阴森恐怖的氛围。

senses.en: to criticize someone with angry, abusive language

example.en: The crowd reviled the politician for his broken promises.
example.zh: 群众因那位政客违背诺言而痛骂他。

senses.en: of a pale purple color

example.en: She wore a mauve dress to the party.
example.zh: 她穿了一条淡紫色的裙子去参加聚会。

senses.en: a pale purple color

example.en: The walls were painted in a soft mauve.
example.zh: 墙壁被漆成了柔和的淡紫色。

senses.en: to give someone too much work or responsibility

example.en: Don't overburden yourself with extra projects.
example.zh: 别用额外的项目把自己压垮。

senses.en: so alike that differences cannot be noticed
senses.zh: 难以区分的，无法辨别的

example.en: The copy is indistinguishable from the original painting.
example.zh: 这幅复制品与原作难以区分。

senses.en: to put something somewhere and then be unable to find it
senses.zh: 把……放错地方而找不到；遗失

example.en: I often misplace my keys when I am in a hurry.
example.zh: 我匆忙时常把钥匙放得找不到。

senses.en: to give something, such as trust, to the wrong person or in the wrong way

example.en: She realized she had misplaced her trust in him.
example.zh: 她意识到自己错信了他。

senses.en: used to introduce a fact that makes the main statement surprising or less simple

example.en: Although it was raining, we went for a walk.
example.zh: 虽然下着雨，我们还是去散步了。

senses.en: up to a particular time and not after

example.en: The shop is open until nine.
example.zh: 这家商店营业到九点。

senses.en: up to the time that something happens

example.en: Wait here until I come back.
example.zh: 在这里等到我回来。

senses.en: painful and tender, especially of a body part

example.en: My throat is sore from all the talking.
example.zh: 说了那么多话，我的嗓子疼。

senses.en: upset or annoyed about something

example.en: She was still sore about losing the game.
example.zh: 她还在为输掉比赛而生气。

senses.en: a painful place on the body, often with broken skin

example.en: The nurse cleaned the sore on his leg.
example.zh: 护士清理了他腿上的疮口。

senses.en: a loose shirt worn especially by women

example.en: She wore a white blouse to the interview.
example.zh: 她穿了一件白衬衫去面试。

senses.en: to ask for information

example.en: She inquired about the train schedule at the counter.
example.zh: 她在柜台询问了火车时刻表。

senses.en: to officially investigate or look into something

example.en: The committee inquired into the cause of the accident.
example.zh: 委员会调查了事故的原因。

senses.en: sad or not satisfied

example.en: She was unhappy with her exam results.
example.zh: 她对考试成绩不满意。

senses.en: unfortunate or unsuitable

example.en: An unhappy accident delayed the whole project.
example.zh: 一场不幸的意外延误了整个项目。

senses.en: a smell, especially one that is noticeable or unpleasant

example.en: A strange odor came from the kitchen.
example.zh: 厨房里传来一股奇怪的气味。

senses.en: a lingering impression or reputation quality (literary use)

example.en: The old house still carried an odor of mystery.
example.zh: 这座老房子仍带着一丝神秘的意味。

senses.en: a failure to follow a law, rule, or agreement; a break or gap

example.en: The company was fined for a breach of contract.
example.zh: 该公司因违约被罚款。

senses.en: to break a law, rule, or agreement; to make a gap in something

example.en: The hackers breached the security system.
example.zh: 黑客攻破了安全系统。

senses.en: the outer shape or outline of something

example.en: The designer admired the smooth contours of the car.
example.zh: 设计师很欣赏这辆汽车流畅的轮廓。

senses.en: a line on a map connecting points of equal height

example.en: The contour lines on the map show how steep the hill is.
example.zh: 地图上的等高线显示这座山有多陡。

senses.en: to shape the outline of something

example.en: The makeup artist contoured her cheekbones with a brush.
example.zh: 化妆师用刷子勾勒出她的颧骨轮廓。

senses.en: to exchange something such as a coupon or points for goods or a reward

example.en: You can redeem this coupon at any store.
example.zh: 你可以在任何一家商店兑换这张优惠券。

senses.en: to make up for past faults; to restore one's good reputation

example.en: He redeemed himself with a strong performance in the final match.
example.zh: 他在决赛中的出色表现挽回了声誉。

senses.en: to buy back or pay off something such as a debt or pawned item

example.en: He worked hard to redeem his pawned watch.
example.zh: 他努力工作以赎回典当的手表。

senses.en: simple plant-like organisms that grow mainly in water; plural of alga

example.en: Green algae covered the surface of the pond.
example.zh: 绿藻覆盖了池塘的表面。

senses.en: strong expression of disapproval

example.en: The attack drew widespread condemnation.
example.zh: 这次袭击招致了广泛谴责。

senses.en: a legal judgment that something is unfit for use or taken for public use

example.en: The building faced condemnation after the safety inspection.
example.zh: 安全检查后，这栋楼面临被宣告不适用的处理。

senses.en: polite and honorable behavior, especially by men toward women

example.en: He opened the door for her out of old-fashioned chivalry.
example.zh: 他出于老式的骑士风度为她开了门。

senses.en: the medieval knightly code of conduct

example.en: Chivalry governed how medieval knights were expected to behave.
example.zh: 骑士精神规范了中世纪骑士应有的行为。

senses.en: to officially take and hold something, such as a vehicle, usually by legal authority

example.en: The police impounded his car because it was illegally parked.
example.zh: 警方因他违规停车而扣押了他的车。

senses.en: the set of gears, or its casing, that controls power in a vehicle or machine

example.en: The car's gearbox makes a strange noise when shifting gears.
example.zh: 这辆车换挡时变速箱发出奇怪的声音。

senses.en: to suffer or cause extreme hunger

example.en: The long blockade famished the city.
example.zh: 长期封锁使全城陷入饥荒。

senses.en: a whip used for controlling horses

example.en: He picked up the horsewhip before the morning ride.
example.zh: 早晨骑马前他拿起了马鞭。

senses.en: to beat someone with a whip

example.en: In the old novel, the stable boy feared being horsewhipped.
example.zh: 在那本旧小说里，马倌害怕被鞭打。

senses.en: children or young people

example.en: The kids are playing in the park.
example.zh: 孩子们正在公园里玩耍。

senses.en: young goats

example.en: The farm has three newborn kids.
example.zh: 农场里有三只刚出生的小山羊。
